title: Audit Assurance module loads and the audit list renders without error
preconditions: Logged in as a user with audit.read permission
expectedResult: AuditAssurance2Content.jsx renders the audit list with no console errors and no failed network requests to /api/audit-assurance.

title: Create a new CAR with default fields via CARDetailDrawer
preconditions: An open finding exists on an active audit
steps: Open the finding and click 'Raise CAR'
Fill in the minimum required fields and submit
expectedResult: The CAR is created with status='open', a valid carReference is displayed, and the CAR appears in the corrective actions list without error.

title: Findings Register tab loads and displays existing findings
preconditions: Audit has at least one finding
steps: Open an audit and click the 'Findings' tab
expectedResult: FindingsRegisterTab.jsx renders the findings table with severity, status, and scope/clause reference columns populated, with no unhandled loading/error state.

title: Audit Closure tab loads checklist, artifacts, and approval status without error
steps: Open the audit and click the 'Closure' tab
expectedResult: AuditClosureTab.jsx fires its parallel getAuditClosure/getAuditClosureChecklist/getAuditClosureArtifacts calls on mount and renders all three sections (checklist, artifacts, approval status) without a blank screen or unhandled promise rejection.
